accuracy.reason: All eight objectives are technically supported: acceptance/completion, two acknowledgement boundaries, atomic duplicate-safe effects, bounded recovery, per-entity ordered effects, finite capacity, independent log groups and caller-dependent async fit.

mechanisms.reason: Commit-before-ack and ack-before-commit crash traces explain duplication/loss; atomic uniqueness closes the effect gap. Concurrent completion, per-key serialization and arrival-minus-completion explain ordering and overload causally.

coherence.reason: HTTP/transaction/rate prerequisites suffice. Cards build handoff before crashes, recovery before ordering and capacity before log choice. Both diagrams preserve acceptance/completion and queue/group distinctions; shared presentation inspected, not executed.

evidence.quote: Committing an offset records progress; it does not delete the event.

decisions.reason: Learner makes supported synchronous login versus deferred export, delayed bounded retry versus quarantine, serialized item effects, admission control and retained-log choices; all stated constraints drive decisions.

evidence.quote: Keep decisions synchronous when the next action requires their result.

clarity.reason: Terms are defined at use and examples distinguish delivery, business effect and status. Atomic deduplication and log cards are detailed but remain self-contained under declared prerequisites.

evidence.quote: Ordered delivery alone does not guarantee ordered effects.

outcomes.reason: All criteria: API/broker/worker trace, configured confirmed handoff before acceptance, saved file/ready before acknowledgement, pending/failed visibility, synchronous access dependency and status-tracking cost.

All criteria: unacknowledged credit can repeat; early acknowledgement loses effect; stable ID, unique durable record and credit in one transaction make repeats no-ops without claiming exactly-once delivery.

All criteria: increasing delays plus finite attempt/time budget, terminal failed/dead-letter path, unsupported format isolated immediately, healthy progress and cause/prior-effect checks before replay. Numeric settings are not required by the criterion.

All criteria: finishes 2 then 5, distinguishes receipt from effect, serializes per item across retries, permits independent items, identifies hot-item throughput cost and unresolved failed predecessor.

All criteria: growth40/s, oldest age means late completion, downstream concurrency cap, visible throttle/reject/bounded defer, finite storage/retention and burst limits, workers only with bottleneck and downstream headroom.

All criteria: queue divides jobs with possible redelivery, separate groups consume independently and share partitions internally, per-group partition offsets do not delete events, replay conditional on retained day, only partition order and no universal external exactly-once.

sourceChecks.claim: Azure async request-reply supports early acceptance with job/status and later completion/failure; it does not shorten the background work.
RabbitMQ confirms explicitly separates publisher confirms from consumer acknowledgements and makes processing/removal an application responsibility.
AWS idempotent-API article requires stable caller ID and ACID coordination of token with mutations; RabbitMQ redelivery confirms the crash window.

Azure retry specifies delayed bounded transient retries; competing-consumers primary followup supports poison isolation/dead-letter inspection. Replay safety follows the preceding atomic-effect lesson.
Azure competing-consumers identifies ordering hazards and keyed sessions; the concurrent-write interleaving and serialized-effects remedy correctly reason beyond delivery order.
Azure load leveling explicitly warns sustained producer excess, downstream contention, bounded processing, producer shedding and finite queue quotas/retention.
Kafka design verifies ordered partitions, group positions, replay and retention independent of consumption, and external-system cooperation for exactly-once effects.
Azure async pattern supports status-observable deferred jobs; keeping access authorization before disclosure follows the stated dependency, with broker/status operation costs.
